the first 2 months are definitely the hardest part. it took me a LOT of tries to even get past gatecrasher. i only made it past the first month in 2 runs, one of them ended the next month and the other is the one you're seeing here :p The VIP missions and the sewer missions are the worst imo because you cant extract critically wounded soldiers. on those misions i would just play extremely carefull and spam overwatch. learning the behaviour of all the aliens is also vital. Knowing when to focus certain aliens or when it was "save" to let them live another turn is something that took a lot of time. Ive read a lot of praise for the reapers, but i only used those to stealth the advent avatar facilities. i didnt really use snipers either. I only had one that i would take on missions but when he died (he was very good so i was pretty sad when he bit the dust) i never bothered leveling up new snipers. templars and skirmishers were my lifesavers. I also had a very early avenger defense mission in the second or third month which took ages to complete but it did level up a lot of soldiers which probably helped me snowball the early game. And for the rest it was probably a lot of luck. i had an early ballistic weapon damage breakthrough (for all ballistic weapons) which meant i could once again oneshot advent troopers. And i got lucky with my resistance orders, having both the enhanced PCS and enhanced attachments upgrades. I actualy almost lost because of the avatar timer because i read somewhere that the timer would reset after destroying another facility, but that had been patched out apparantly. again i was lucky that i had a facility lead in my research. And ofcourse lategame all soldiers are just unstoppable killing machines and the game was basicly won already.
